body:
# ⚠️FORGE VERSION IS THE BEST WORKING VERSION!⚠️

💻 Advanced Codes: The Ultimate Hacker Toolkit

Advanced Codes is a professional-grade hacker toolkit designed for Minecraft 1.21.x world manipulation. Built for map makers, server admins, and content creators, this mod moves beyond standard commands to provide 5 high-impact digital protocols that manipulate physics, entity databases, and player capabilities.

This version is optimized for Minecraft 1.21.x and features a dual-compatibility architecture, supporting both Legacy Forge and NeoForge loaders seamlessly.
🔥 Active Protocols & Command Guide

Each protocol is activated via the in-game chat (T) using specific commands. All feedback is displayed in a clean "System Terminal" aesthetic.

    Note: Operator (OP) permissions are required to execute these commands.

1. God Hand Protocol (/godhand)

    Description: Grants the user the power of "Entity Purge." While active, any entity you strike is not just killed—it is deleted from existence.

    Technical Detail: It bypasses standard death cycles by using the discard() method. No loot is dropped, no XP is granted, and no death animation is played. The entity is removed from the world database instantly.

    Terminal Output: GodHand Protocol: STABLE (ON) / GodHand Protocol: OFFLINE (OFF)

2. Hacker Status (/hackermode)

    Description: Elevates the user to a "Superuser" status, combining ultimate mobility with invincibility.

    Technical Detail: Directly manipulates player capabilities to grant Flight (mayfly), Invulnerability (invulnerable), and Invisibility (MobEffects.INVISIBILITY) simultaneously.

    Terminal Output: Hacker Status: ANONYMOUS (ON) / Hacker Status: DE-AUTH (OFF)

3. Environment Scan (/scan)

    Description: Initiates a high-range ESP (Extra Sensory Perception) sweep. This is an instantaneous command for situational awareness.

    Technical Detail: Scans a 50-block radius around the player. All detected LivingEntities are highlighted with a 30-second Glow effect, making them visible through solid walls.

    Terminal Output: Environment Scan: COMPLETE.

4. Time Warp Protocol (/timewarp)

    Description: Bends the flow of time and physics. Creates a "Matrix-style" effect where everyone else slows down while you move normally.

    Technical Detail: While active, the DeltaMovement (velocity) of every entity except the player is reduced to 10% (0.1x speed). Projectiles, explosions, and mobs are frozen in near-stasis.

    Terminal Output: Time Warp Protocol: ACTIVE (ON) / Time Warp Protocol: OFFLINE (OFF)

5. Inventory Leak (/dropitems)

    Description: Exploits entity equipment slots to force-eject all items. Perfect for disarming enemies or looting without combat.

    Technical Detail: Scans all LivingEntities within a 30-block radius. It iterates through every EquipmentSlot (Armor, Mainhand, Offhand), spawns a copy of the item in the world, and clears the target's slot.

    Terminal Output: Inventory Leak: SUCCESS. Items dropped for [X] targets.

💻 Technical Specifications

    MC Version: 1.21.x

    Loader Support: Universal Dual-Load (Supports both Forge and NeoForge).

    Architecture: High-performance Event-Bus system.

    UI Theme: Modern Cyber / System Terminal Aesthetic.

    Developer: Meriç (OxygenForge-code).

📥 Installation

    Ensure you have either Forge or NeoForge 1.21.x installed.

    Drop the .jar file into your Minecraft mods folder.

    Launch the game and enjoy total control over your world.
